claim_ceiling: CANDIDATE_ONLY. A self-assessment by the party that did the work; proposals below are NOT adopted and require owner authorisation.

self_research.finding: A lane turn has a bounded editing budget and an unbounded command-execution budget; the wedge surface is command execution, not editing or reasoning.
self_research.evidence: EXECUTE attempts BC1 and BC2 wedged at the 900 s timeout after each had written its first file; the same change set as an edit-only turn (BC3) completed in 74 s.
self_research.disconfirming_check: The identity gate passed on BC3 alone (aggregate verdict: required_arm == served_arm == opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash, usage_receipt_ok true, rank 1). BC1's ATTEMPT-level attribution names the mandated arm but its aggregate verdict is ok:false / usage_receipt_ok:false / served_arm:null, and BC2 has no receipt, so the arm claim is supported for the completing turn only. An attempt-level field is not the arm-identity gate.

self_research.finding: In a candidate-only round the strongest evidence is a before/after contrast across two roots rather than a pass at one.
self_research.evidence: Identical fixtures returned exit 3 on the canonical root and exit 0 / allow / no-session-id-unattributable on the candidate root.

self_research.finding: Independent verification has a ceiling that is not 'agreement'; the checker stated it itself.
self_research.evidence: V2 claim_B/claim_C AGREE, with the caveat 'These are declaration checks, not proof of actual backend effort.' Model selection is proven at the declaration and transport layer only.

self_research.finding: A contradiction inside a brief surfaces as a lane's refusal, not as self-review.
self_research.evidence: The V1 checker brief both forbade all writes and required fixtures; the checker returned UNCERTAIN and named the contradiction. The defect was in the brief.

self_learning.rule: Make EXECUTE turns edit-only; the orchestrator owns RED/GREEN.
Scope a checker brief's writes to its own work directory; never forbid a capability the brief requires; treat UNCERTAIN as a brief defect signal.
Run one detection list at both roots; annotate root-dependent expectations instead of rewriting raw statuses.
Gate an evidence packet before publishing; verify the remote by git blob sha rather than by push output.
Terminate a wedged attempt only on measurement, and leave a TERMINATION.json.

self_iteration.proposal: Adopt edit-only as the default EXECUTE turn shape with the oracle orchestrator-side.
self_iteration.trigger: any brief whose change set needs verification
self_iteration.cost: the lane receipt will not contain a GREEN; the orchestrator detection list becomes the primary oracle

self_iteration.proposal: Add a brief-lint step to the admission chain: does the brief forbid a capability it requires, and would a correct reader be forced into UNCERTAIN?
self_iteration.cost: minutes; it would have saved a 413 s checker turn

self_iteration.proposal: Make the two-root detection list mandatory for candidate-only rounds.
self_iteration.trigger: any round with a candidate/canonical split

self_iteration.proposal: Require the lane runner itself to emit TERMINATION.json when a supervising process stops an attempt.
Price F1 (routes[].PLAN outlier) as a bounded rebind task with its own WorkOrder so it stops recurring as a residual.
self_iteration.cost: one config change plus the conformance re-run

self_iteration.proposal: Record per round which lane shape was used and how many attempts it took (this round: 3 EXECUTE attempts, 1 success).

must_not_be_inferred: That the lanes are reliable in general. The supported claim is narrower: each of the three arms was served and identity-matched in the attempts that completed, on this host, in this session; 3 EXECUTE attempts produced 1 completing turn.
must_not_change: The promotion gate. This round did not promote its own candidate even though its own proposals would have made that cheap; an agent that widens its own authority because its work looked good has no separation of duties left.
self_evolution.authorisation_required_from: the owner; no agent may adopt these
